scope: Observed single-byte WinInnwa /F4 font subsets, keyed by SHA-256 of the embedded font program. Not a universal raw-byte map; no production parser is wired to this file.
method: All sample pages. A byte is admitted only when the existing WinInnwa decoder produces one code point via its legacy bridge, the code point is not flagged in either sample, it has no overlapping current output from another observed byte in the same font, and it does not contradict the previously reviewed sample map. Offline comparison uses that existing decoder, which currently reads the font ToUnicode bridge. No vector matching, cleanup, or reordering is used here. Absence of scorer flags is not proof of correctness. resolvedForReview records the previously reviewed values and context-based corrections; flagged and ambiguous entries remain separate from the 1:1 candidate list. These are not a complete verified font map. Book1 18/1C and the 25 writing restriction follow the user-supplied glyph rules; engine syllable evidence alone is not proof that an ambiguous glyph has one particular reading.

visualOrderRules.scope: Raw slots first; rearrange these leading slots only after decoding. Suffix slots remain in their existing order. No other marks are normalized by these rules. Raw orphan flags are retained and do not themselves mean an error.

visualOrderEvidenceMethod: All observed page-stream runs under provisional seed values. Compares raw orphan flags to flags after applying only the four shared patterns; unknown/empty byte values are boundaries. Pattern matches and changes in flags are evidence of visual order, not verification of byte meanings or overall accuracy. Form XObjects are not scanned.
